twi: Nsuo yɛ adeɛ a ɛho hia ma nkwa. Nnipa, mmoa ne afifideɛ hia nsuo na wɔatena ase.
Sukuu yɛ beaeɛ a asuafoɔ kɔ sua adeɛ na wɔnya nimdeɛ ne nteteeɛ.
Kɔmputa yɛ mfiri a ɛtumi gye nsɛm, yɛ ho adwuma, sie nsɛm na ɛma nsɛm a wɔhwehwɛ ba.
Artificial intelligence yɛ mfiridwuma a ɛma kɔmputa tumi yɛ nnwuma bi a mpɛn pii no nnipa na wɔyɛ.
Machine learning yɛ AI fã a ɛma kɔmputa sua nsusuiɛ ne nhwɛsoɔ fi data mu na ɛde yɛ nkɔmhyɛ anaa gyinaesi.
Internet yɛ kɔmputa ne nkitahodie nhyehyɛe kɛseɛ a ɛma mfiri ne nnipa tumi di nkitaho wɔ wiase nyinaa.
Data yɛ nsɛm anaa nneɛma a wɔaboaboa ano sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yie sɛ wɔde yɛ nhwehwɛmu anaa gyinaesi.
Database yɛ data a wɔahyehyɛ no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yie sɛ wɔbɛsie, ahwehwɛ na wɔayɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ ho.
Cybersecurity yɛ akwan a wɔfa so bɔ kɔmputa, network, application ne data ho ban fi nneɛma a wɔmma ho kwan ho.
Network yɛ mfiri a wɔaka abom sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yie sɛ wɔne wɔn ho wɔn ho bɛdi nkitaho na wɔakyɛ nneɛma.
Router yɛ network mfiri a ɛde data packets fi network baako kɔ network foforɔ mu.
Switch yɛ network mfiri a ɛka mfiri bom wɔ local network mu na ɛde data kɔ destination device no nkyɛn.
Password yɛ ahintasɛm nsɛm a wɔde hwɛ sɛ obi a ɔrebɔ system no mu no wɔ kwan sɛ ɔbɛkɔ mu.
Authentication yɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so hwɛ sɛnea obi anaa mfiri no yɛ nea ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ no ankasa.
Education yɛ adesua ne nteteeɛ a ɛboa obi nya nimdeɛ, nimdeɛ a wɔde yɛ adwuma, ne suban pa.
Ɔdɔ yɛ nkateɛ a ɛma obi kyerɛ obi foforɔ ayamye, ahummɔborɔ ne ɔpɛ pa.
Anigyeɛ yɛ tebea a obi te nka sɛ ne ho yɛ no fɛ na ne koma ani gye.
Ahokyere yɛ tebea a ɛma obi hyia ɔhaw anaa adwene mu nnesoɔ na ɛhia mmoa anaa ano aduru.
Twi yɛ Akan kasa a nnipa pii ka wɔ Ghana, titiriw Asante ne Akuapem Twi kasafoɔ mu.
Ghana yɛ ɔman a ɛwɔ West Africa na ne kurow kɛseɛ ne Accra.
Computer science yɛ adesua a ɛfa kɔmputa, algorithms, software, data ne ɔhaw ahodoɔ a wɔde kɔmputa di ho.
Programming yɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so kyerɛ kɔmputa nea ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ denam code a wɔkyerɛw so.
Python yɛ programming kasa a ne syntax yɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔbɛkenkan na wɔde yɛ web development, data science ne machine learning.
Web development yɛ web pages ne web applications a wɔyɛ na wɔhwɛ so denam HTML, CSS, JavaScript ne server technologies so.
AI betumi aboa wɔ healthcare, education, banking, transportation ne customer service mu denam automation ne data analysis so.
Machine learning betumi aboa ma wɔde data ayɛ nkɔmhyɛ, ahu nhwɛsoɔ na wɔama gyinaesi ayɛ ntɛm.
Information yɛ data a wɔayɛ ho adwuma na wɔama no ase sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yie sɛ ɛbɛma nteaseɛ ne nimdeɛ.
Mobile phone yɛ ɛlɛtrɔnik mfiri a wɔde di nkitaho, frɛ, kyerɛw nsɛm na wɔde internet di dwuma.
Social media yɛ online platforms a ɛma nnipa tumi di nkitaho, kyɛ nsɛm na wɔyɛ community.
Cloud computing yɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so de computing resources te sɛ storage ne processing ma obi wɔ network so bere a ɔhia no.
Internet of Things yɛ mfiri a sensors ne connectivity wom a ɛtumi boaboa data ano na ɛde data no fa network so.
Data analysis yɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so hwehwɛ data, te ase na wɔde nya nsɛm a ɛboa gyinaesi.
DBMS yɛ software a wɔde yɛ, sie, hwehwɛ, sesa na wɔhwɛ databases so.
Encryption yɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so sesa readable data ma ɛyɛ encoded form sɛnea nnipa a wɔmma ho kwan rentumi nkenkan no ntɛm.
Firewall yɛ security control a ɛhwɛ network traffic na ɛma anaa ɛbara connections sɛnea security rules kyerɛ.
Phishing yɛ nnaadaa a wɔde bɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛma obi ama wɔn password anaa personal information denam nkra anaa website a ɛyɛ nnaadaa so.
Chatbot yɛ software a ɛne nnipa di nkitaho denam kasa a nnipa de di dwuma so.
Question answering system yɛ application a egye asɛmmisa fi user hɔ na ɛhwehwɛ anaa ɛyɛ answer a ɛfa asɛmmisa no ho.
